scope.flow: UnstakeMessenger cross-chain send with feeBufferBPS overpayment via inherited OAppSender._lzSend/_payNative

entities.name: User or frontend sending cross-chain message

statements.text: UnstakeMessenger contains a feeBufferBPS state variable intended to let users or frontends include a safety buffer in msg.value.
A user attempts to use the feeBufferBPS feature by sending msg.value equal to fee plus buffer.
The user's cross-chain send is routed through the inherited OAppSender._lzSend function.
The internal _payNative helper in OAppSender strictly validates that msg.value equals the exact required native fee, and UnstakeMessenger does not override this behavior.
When a user sends fee plus the configured feeBufferBPS buffer, the buffered overpayment path should be accepted rather than rejected.
The inherited _payNative exact-equality check should not reject a msg.value that exceeds the required native fee when the buffer feature is enabled.
The "Safe/Buffered" transaction path is permanently broken.
the protocol fails to deliver the promised reliability feature.

ambiguities: Report does not state whether feeBufferBPS is enabled by default or must be configured before the send.
Report does not specify the exact numeric buffer value or the required fee amount.
Report does not establish whether the user is authorized or permissionless; actor is described generically as user/frontend.
Funds are not lost (they revert) is stated as a non-harm and was not treated as an impact.
